name: zcode-trae-connect
description: Bring Trae desktop-app models (Trae CN & TRAE SOLO CN, plus an optional remote laptop Trae) into ZCode as OpenAI-compatible providers through the local trae2api gateway — zero configuration and safe against server-side token-family rotation.

description_i18n.en: Bring Trae desktop-app models (Trae CN & TRAE SOLO CN, plus an optional remote laptop Trae) into ZCode as OpenAI-compatible providers through the local trae2api gateway — zero configuration and safe against server-side token-family rotation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过本地 trae2api 网关，把 Trae 桌面 App 的模型（Trae CN、TRAE SOLO CN，可选远程笔记本 Trae）零配置接入 ZCode，作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商，并规避服务端令牌族自动轮换的风险。
